sections.title: Compressible Flow and Combustion for Rocket Engines
sections.description: The topics include the governing equations and thermodynamic relations, compressible effects, speed of sound, 1D isentropic flow of an ideal gas, flow in a converging-diverging nozzle, choked flow, Fanno-line flow, Rayleigh-line flow, normal and oblique shock waves, expansion and compression in supersonic flow; CFD for internal and external flows, CFD for compressible flows and stability condition; Ansys-FLUENT for compressible flows; thermodynamics of combustion, stoichiometry, equilibrium and dissociation, chemical kinetics, reaction rate, combustion models; turbulence and turbulence models; rocket engines, engine nozzle with exhaust plume, simulation of combustion in a rocket engine.
